root: bun repo - Tool-neutral build entry with two implementations: Nx with Bun (default) and Bazel.
Usage:
bun repo [--tool=nx|bazel] <command> [options] [-- <arguments>]
bun repo <command> --help [--lang=en|de]
Commands:
run <project:target[:configuration]>            Run one task of one project.
run-many --targets=<targets> [--projects=<projects>]
Run the same targets in many projects.
affected --targets=<targets>                    Run targets in the projects changed against HEAD and their dependents.
exec --projects=<projects> -- <command>         Run a command once per selected project, in the project root.
watch --projects=<projects> -- <command>        Rerun a command when selected source files change.
graph                                           Print the tool-neutral build graph.
show projects|project <name>|targets            Print projects, one project or all targets of the neutral graph.
reset                                           Invalidate the graph and reset the selected tool's local state.
tools setup [nx|bazel|all]                      Provision the pinned build tools for this host.
preflight                                       Check the host against the finite requirements before any store is provisioned.
dependencies sync|lock --all|--scope <owner>    Install or lock the workspace dependencies.
cargo --store=shared|isolated --configuration=prototype|release [--parallelism=<cores>] -- <cargo subcommand> <args>
Compile through the repository's Cargo ingress gate.
cache status|clear                              Show or clear the selected tool's local task cache.
Options:
-p, --projects=<projects>                       Comma list of project names with * wildcards, tag:<tag>, name:<name>, directory:<root> and !<pattern> negation. (used by: run-many, exec, watch)
--exclude=<projects>                            Comma list of projects to leave out (same patterns as --projects). (used by: run-many, affected, exec, watch)
-t, --targets=<targets>, --target               Comma list of target names or * patterns. (used by: run-many, affected)

-c, --configuration=<prototype|release>         Compiler configuration; disagreeing values (also a :<configuration> suffix or SEMIO_BUILD_MODE) are refused; cargo takes the full name only. (used by: run, run-many, affected, cargo)
--parallel=<n>                                  Maximum number of concurrent tasks. (used by: run, run-many, affected)
--bail                                          Stop at the first failing task. (used by: run, run-many, affected)
--verbose                                       Print more detail. (used by: run, run-many, affected)
--output=<stream|stream-without-prefixes|static>, --output-style
Output style of the task logs. (used by: run, run-many, affected)
--skip-cache                                    Ignore the task cache. (used by: run, run-many, affected)
--skip-remote-cache                             Ignore the remote cache. (used by: run, run-many, affected)
--exclude-dependencies, --exclude-task-dependencies
Run only the named tasks, not the tasks they depend on. (used by: run, run-many, affected)
--dry-run                                       Print the task graph as a DryRunPlan on stdout and execute nothing; the same for every tool. (used by: run, run-many, affected, exec)

--graph[=<file>]                                Same as --dry-run; with a file the plan is written there (Nx: the file as given, Bazel: a report whose path is printed). (used by: run, run-many, affected, exec)
--all                                           Select every project (affected, watch) or every dependency owner (dependencies). (used by: affected, watch, dependencies)
--base=<ref>                                    Compare against this revision instead of HEAD. (used by: affected)
--head=<ref>                                    End revision of the comparison. (used by: affected)
--files=<files>                                 Comma list of changed files instead of the git comparison. (used by: affected)
--uncommitted                                   Only uncommitted changes. (used by: affected)
--untracked                                     Only untracked files. (used by: affected)
--include-global-files                          Also react to files outside any project. (used by: watch)
--file=<path>                                   Write the result as a report file and print its path. (used by: graph, show)
--json                                          Print lists as JSON instead of one entry per line. (used by: graph, show)
--scope <owner>                                 Restrict the operation to one dependency owner. (used by: dependencies)
--store=<shared|isolated>                       Cargo target store; never create a private target directory. (used by: cargo)
--parallelism=<cores>                           Positive number of cores for Cargo. (used by: cargo)
Global options:
--tool=<nx|bazel>   Select the build implementation; otherwise SEMIO_BUILD_TOOL, then the policy default (nx).
--workers=<on|off>  Run actions in persistent workers (on) or in one process each (off); otherwise SEMIO_BUILD_WORKERS, then the worker policy of the build policy.
-h, --help          Print the usage of the command and stop.
--lang=<en|de>      Help language (with --help); otherwise SEMIO_LANGUAGE, then the locale, then the first catalogue language.
Examples:
bun repo run @semio-tech/semio-tech-play:serve
Run the serve task with the default implementation.
bun repo run-many --targets=test --projects=tag:rust
Run the test target in every project tagged rust.
bun repo affected --targets=test
Test what changed against HEAD plus untracked files.
bun repo exec --projects=@semio-tech/repo-client -- bun test
Run one command inside one project root.
bun repo watch --projects=@semio-tech/repo-client -- bun repo run @semio-tech/repo-client:build
Rebuild one project on every source change.
bun repo graph --file=graph.json
Write the graph as a report file.
bun repo show projects
List all projects.
bun repo reset --tool=bazel
Reset the Bazel state.
bun repo tools setup all
Provision Nx and Bazel.
bun repo preflight
Check architecture, free space, tools and directory exchange.
bun repo dependencies lock --all
Regenerate the lock after editing a package.json.
bun repo cargo --store=shared --configuration=prototype -- check -p <crate> --lib
Type-check one crate in the shared store.
bun repo cache status --tool=bazel
Show the Bazel disk cache and build activity.

root: bun repo - Werkzeugneutraler Build-Einstieg mit zwei Implementierungen: Nx mit Bun (Standard) und Bazel.
Verwendung:
bun repo [--tool=nx|bazel] <command> [optionen] [-- <arguments>]
bun repo <command> --help [--lang=en|de]
Befehle:
run <project:target[:configuration]>            Führt eine Task eines Projekts aus.
run-many --targets=<targets> [--projects=<projects>]
Führt dieselben Targets in mehreren Projekten aus.
affected --targets=<targets>                    Führt Targets in den gegenüber HEAD geänderten Projekten und deren Abhängigen aus.
exec --projects=<projects> -- <command>         Führt einen Befehl einmal je gewähltem Projekt im Projektstamm aus.
watch --projects=<projects> -- <command>        Führt einen Befehl erneut aus, wenn gewählte Quelldateien sich ändern.
graph                                           Gibt den werkzeugneutralen Build-Graphen aus.
show projects|project <name>|targets            Gibt Projekte, ein Projekt oder alle Targets des neutralen Graphen aus.
reset                                           Verwirft den Graphen und setzt den lokalen Zustand des gewählten Werkzeugs zurück.
tools setup [nx|bazel|all]                      Richtet die gepinnten Build-Werkzeuge für diesen Rechner ein.
preflight                                       Prüft den Rechner gegen die endlichen Anforderungen, bevor ein Speicher bereitgestellt wird.
dependencies sync|lock --all|--scope <owner>    Installiert oder sperrt die Abhängigkeiten des Workspace.
cargo --store=shared|isolated --configuration=prototype|release [--parallelism=<cores>] -- <cargo subcommand> <args>
Kompiliert über das Cargo-Eingangstor des Repositorys.
cache status|clear                              Zeigt den lokalen Task-Cache des gewählten Werkzeugs an oder leert ihn.
Optionen:

-p, --projects=<projects>                       Kommaliste von Projektnamen mit *-Platzhaltern, tag:<tag>, name:<name>, directory:<root> und !<Muster> als Verneinung. (verwendet von: run-many, exec, watch)
--exclude=<projects>                            Kommaliste auszuschließender Projekte (gleiche Muster wie --projects). (verwendet von: run-many, affected, exec, watch)

--workers=<on|off>  Führt Aktionen in persistenten Workern (on) oder je in einem eigenen Prozess (off) aus; sonst SEMIO_BUILD_WORKERS, dann die Worker-Policy der Build-Policy.
-h, --help          Gibt die Verwendung des Befehls aus und endet.
--lang=<en|de>      Sprache der Hilfe (mit --help); sonst SEMIO_LANGUAGE, dann die Locale, dann die erste Katalogsprache.
Beispiele:
bun repo cargo --store=shared --configuration=prototype -- check -p <crate> --lib
Prüft eine Crate im gemeinsamen Speicher.
cache: bun repo cache - Zeigt den lokalen Task-Cache des gewählten Werkzeugs an oder leert ihn.
Verwendung:
bun repo [--tool=nx|bazel] cache status|clear
Unterbefehle:
cache status  Gibt einen CacheStatus aus: Einträge, Bytes und, für Bazel, die aufgezeichnete Build-Aktivität.
cache clear   Leert den Cache und gibt einen CacheClear aus.
